plugins.description: Connect BacklinkGPT to your agent: OAuth MCP server for prospect memory, SEO data, sending and reply detection, and the autopilot stages your agent can take over, plus six link-building skills: setup, finding link targets, judging pages, writing pitches, handling replies and negotiating, and the weekly report.
